why_ai: Unlicensed proposal writing that AI drafting substitutes heavily, softened by funder relationships and persuasion.
why_clarity: Proposals follow templates, but wins are noisy at 10-25% and decided months later.
why_digital: Guidelines and documents in, proposals submitted through portals, writers hired remotely.

why_ai: Structured funder report formats on predictable deadlines are directly automatable from programme data.
why_clarity: Quarterly and annual reports follow funder-specific templates checked against requirements.
why_digital: Financial and programme data in, funder reports out, all documents.

why_ai: Scores are assembled from public wealth indicators AI can gather, though joined giving history helps.
why_clarity: Every constituent file is scored the same way, but scores are rarely validated against giving.
why_digital: Public records and client files in, scores and profiles out, sold as data.

why_ai: Source data is entirely public, so the entity-resolution layer is readily replicated by AI.
why_clarity: Recipient resolution and programme classification are checkable against the award corpus.
why_digital: Public award data in, structured intelligence out, sold online.

why_ai: Accountable federal officials run confidential review processes that policy will keep human-led.
why_clarity: Review procedure is codified, but whether the right science was funded shows years later.
why_digital: Proposals and scores handled digitally, run inside agencies with no commercial buyer.

why_ai: Rigid federal templates and compliance rules are well suited to AI-assisted drafting and checking.
why_clarity: Agency templates and review criteria are explicit, but scores arrive months after submission.
why_digital: Documents built on screens and submitted through federal portals.

why_ai: Success turns on cultivated relationships with programme officers that AI cannot hold.
why_clarity: Framing for each funder's preferences is instinctive and results are slow and noisy.
why_digital: Proposals are digital, but cultivation happens in meetings with often-local funders.

why_ai: Programme officers set strategy and judge grantees; endowments will keep paying for that judgement.
why_clarity: What grantmaking accomplished is debated and known years later, if ever.
why_digital: Proposals are digital, but field research and grantee relationships involve site visits.

why_ai: Small firms produce proposals AI increasingly drafts, protected only by writers' funder knowledge.
why_clarity: Deadlines are absolute, but what each funder responds to lives in writers' heads.
why_digital: Proposal writing happens on screens and clients hire firms remotely.

why_ai: Funder profiles from public filings and matching are tasks AI agents can replicate.
why_clarity: Matching programmes to funders recurs at scale with eligibility as an objective check.
why_digital: Filings in, subscription database out, sold online.

why_ai: The credential's authority protects the body, but AI may erode the profession it certifies.
why_clarity: Psychometric exams against defined competency frameworks recur each cycle.
why_digital: Exams and standards delivered digitally to a national candidate pool.

why_ai: Applications joined to funding decisions across many funders is a unique, durable dataset.
why_clarity: In-product analytics recompute defined pipeline metrics each grant cycle.
why_digital: Application data in, software analytics out, sold to funders as SaaS.

why_ai: Pass-through compliance chains and local government relationships slow full AI substitution.
why_clarity: Rules chain across levels of government, and award outcomes come slowly.
why_digital: Documents and portals throughout, but municipalities favour local consultants.

why_ai: Evaluation design and fieldwork interviews need methodological judgement AI only assists.
why_clarity: Each study is designed fresh and its validity is judged slowly.
why_digital: Programme data plus interviews in, evaluation reports out.

why_ai: Matching structured opportunity databases to organisation profiles is rule logic AI does directly.
why_clarity: Eligibility, geography and mission fit are checkable criteria applied repeatedly.
why_digital: Databases and profiles in, matched opportunities out, entirely online.

why_ai: Long-running giving series carry credibility, though analysis and writing are automatable.
why_clarity: Annual studies repeat, but giving estimates cannot be checked quickly.
why_digital: Survey and filing data in, published reports out.

why_ai: Boilerplate libraries and compliance checklists are exactly what LLM tools now replace.
why_clarity: Content reuse and checklist compliance are defined, repeatable and checkable.
why_digital: Software built and sold online.

why_ai: Community trust and in-person presence matter where connectivity is poor and capacity is thin.
why_clarity: Many agencies' templates apply, but each community's case differs and awards come slowly.
why_digital: Writing is digital, but engagement is local and in person with limited internet.

why_ai: Technical and commercial narratives need domain depth, but founders can increasingly draft with AI.
why_clarity: Agency formats are fixed, yet each innovation needs a novel argument judged months later.
why_digital: Technical documents written and submitted online by remote specialists.

why_ai: A licensed CPA must sign the statutory single audit and carries the liability.
why_clarity: Uniform guidance and the compliance supplement codify tests applied across many grantees.
why_digital: Records-based testing with some on-site fieldwork, often by regional CPA firms.

why_ai: Short templated proposals are precisely what nonprofits can now draft themselves with AI.
why_clarity: High-volume short proposals follow simple formats, with noisy local funding decisions.
why_digital: Documents and email throughout, but writers are found through local networks.

why_ai: Institutional sign-off and faculty relationships protect the office, though drafting support automates.
why_clarity: Federal deadlines and compliance steps are fixed, but funding outcomes arrive months later.
why_digital: Proposal work is digital, done on campus with faculty face to face.
